vision.name: Playful Punch
vision.text:
(If the highest power level on your MP's Level 4 is 500,000 or less, you may play this card to stop a non-Styled attack instead of as an attack.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Your MP gains 5 stages. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
vision.review: never officially released: image is overlaid with 'NEVER OFFICIALLY RELEASED' and most text is hidden. Text shown is copied from the card it reprints (S05 #79); visible fragments match, but exact wording on this printing is unconfirmed
